The Semantic Layer and Certified HR KPIs

An extended practical guide to the semantic layer and certified hr kpis, built for People Analytics leaders, practitioners and data teams.

17 min read · Extended English edition · Gabriel Croitoru

09

This article expands the LinkedIn presentation into a practical framework for People Analytics leaders, practitioners and data teams. It focuses on the choices that make workforce information trusted, explainable and decision-ready.

01 · Deep dive

A contract with users

A contract with users must be treated as an explicit part of the analytical product, not as an undocumented implementation detail. Define the business purpose, population, time basis, owner, control and failure behaviour. Then connect the rule to evidence that can be reviewed when data, structures or stakeholder expectations change. In the context of the semantic layer and certified hr kpis, this is what makes the outcome reusable, auditable and explainable.

02 · Deep dive

In the context of the semantic layer and certified hr kpis, this is what makes the outcome reusable, auditable and explainable.

Apply it

Document the rule, assign an owner, define a threshold or acceptance condition, and specify what users see when the control fails.
